result:
Excellent! I've successfully implemented the scheduled publish feature for the blog application. Here's what I changed:

## Implementation Summary

### Database & Schema
- Added `publishedAt: text('published_at')` nullable column to the posts table in `db/schema.ts`
- Created migration `db/migrations/20260930051500_add_published_at/migration.sql` to add the column to the database

### Data Layer
- Updated `Post` model to include `publishedAt` in the fillable array
- Updated `PostResource` to include both `publishedAt` (ISO 8601 timestamp for responses) and `publishAt` (raw database value for form mapping)

### Validation & Authorization
- Added `publishAt` field to `PostPayloadSchema` as an optional ISO 8601 datetime that accepts null
- Updated `PostPolicy.view()` to allow viewing only if post is published (no date or date in past) OR user is the author
- Added `isPublished()` helper method to determine publication status

### Controllers
- Updated `index()` to filter out scheduled posts except for the author
- Updated `search()` to filter out scheduled posts except for the author  
- Updated `show()` to use authorization check to enforce scheduled post visibility rules
- Updated `store()` and `update()` to map `publishAt` from request to `publishedAt` in database

### Frontend Pages
- Updated `New.tsx` to include "Publish at" datetime-local input field
- Updated `Edit.tsx` to include "Publish at" field with form initialization
- Updated `Show.tsx` to display scheduled publish date for the post author

### Console Command
- Created `app/Console/Commands/ScheduledPostsCommand.ts` that outputs scheduled posts in tab-separated format: `<id>\t<title>\t<published_at>` (soonest first)
- Registered the command in `src/console.ts`

The implementation meets all requirements: posts can be scheduled with an optional publish date, scheduled posts are hidden from non-authors, posts automatically become public once their publish time passes, authors can see scheduled posts with their dates, and there's a console command for checking the schedule. All tests pass and typecheck is clean.
